主要内容: Tom Steyer, a billionaire and a key figure in the 2020 presidential campaign, acknowledged that he still holds some investments in hydrocarbons. During an MSNBC Climate Forum, he explained that these holdings were made years ago and that he has been unable to fully unwind them. Steyer, who has positioned environmental issues as a central part of his campaign, was asked about his complete liquidation of oil, gas, and coal holdings. Some of these investments were acquired while he was running Farallon Capital Management, an investment company. His comments highlight the ongoing tension between his environmental advocacy and his financial interests in the fossil fuel industry.
